units.source_text: 可是，他的风景画必须摒弃这个山谷的染房所喜爱的艳丽颜色的影响。

en.t: However, his landscape paintings had to cast off the influence of the brilliant colors favored by the dye houses in this valley.

units.source_text: 竹林是幽寂恬静而明朗的，却不是淡然无味的。

en.t: The bamboo grove was secluded, calm, and bright, yet it was not bland or flavorless.

units.source_text: 竹林要比松林难画得多。

en.t: A bamboo grove is far more difficult to paint than a pine grove.
